propositions: rebar metrics command output is not currently consulted by rebar-janitor during code-health discovery phase, limiting findings to single-snapshot analysis rather than trend-based evidence
rebar metrics surface lacks documentation entry point for users and agents to discover what metrics are available and when to use them

rebar-janitor discovery phase should run `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` and cite registered code-health-lens metric values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, module-size trend vs 800-line cap, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as durable historical evidence

docs/user-guide.md must document the four metric lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and unavailable state so contributors and agents can locate and understand the metrics surface
docs/reuse-surface.md must expose the rebar.metrics registry subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative) as a reusable library interface for external consumers
AGENTS.md where-to-read pointer list must include a metrics reference to guide agents to user-guide.md and reuse-surface.md
